finalLabel: The scene opens with a shaky, handheld shot following a person running away down an urban alley. A male voice is heard shouting \"No!\". The camera then focuses on a man, played by Nicolas Cage, who has stopped and is watching the other person run away. He has a distraught and resigned expression on his face. The setting is a gritty alley next to a brick building with a sign for \"Perpetual Mercy Hospital\". The visual style is realistic and raw, emphasizing the emotional turmoil of the moment.
